title: .harness.yaml
description: Configuration file for the AI-assisted PR pipeline driven by ai-harness: assess-risk, code-review, and reviewer-brief.

assess-risk.description: Risk-classification stage. The four tier blocks live under 'categories'; ai-harness reads them and walks critical->high->medium->low to assign exactly one tier to each PR.

enabled.description: When false, classification still runs (review/brief need a tier) but no risk label or triage comment is applied.

categories.description: Per-tier configuration. Each tier requires 'patterns' and optionally accepts 'max-lines' / 'max-files'.

low.description: DEPRECATED: moved under assess-risk.categories.<tier>; top-level kept for backwards-compat during migration.

medium.description: DEPRECATED: moved under assess-risk.categories.<tier>; top-level kept for backwards-compat during migration.

high.description: DEPRECATED: moved under assess-risk.categories.<tier>; top-level kept for backwards-compat during migration.

critical.description: DEPRECATED: moved under assess-risk.categories.<tier>; top-level kept for backwards-compat during migration.

code-review.description: Code review stage configuration: per-tier model selection and the system prompt sent to the reviewer.

enabled.description: When false, no Claude code review runs on PR pushes.

prompt.description: System prompt for the code review action.

reviewer-brief.description: Reviewer-brief stage configuration: per-tier model selection and the prompt for the pr-pre-reviewer agent.

enabled.description: When false, no reviewer brief is posted on PR pushes.

threshold-value.description: Non-negative integer threshold or the literal '*' meaning unlimited.

tier.description: Risk tier configuration. 'patterns' lists gitignore-style globs matched against changed file paths; optional 'max-lines'/'max-files' escalate to this tier when exceeded.

patterns.description: Gitignore-style glob patterns for this tier.

model-string.description: Claude model identifier (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-8') or the literal 'skip' to disable this stage for the given tier.

tier-models.description: Per-tier model selection. 'default' is the fallback used by any tier that does not set its own model; individual tier keys override the default.
